judgements.reason: Substrate keeps hardening (Natoma/Snowflake MCP gateway enforcing per-tool-call identity, May 31 bridge), and the Q3 2026 statutory landing is still open. The June 4 Great American AI Act draft proposes a 3-year preemption of state *development* rules, but it explicitly leaves state *use/deployment* rules intact, and agent-identity registration / call-chain logging / per-action consent is a use-and-deployment regime, so it does not yet outdate the `because`/`so_that`. Worth a federal-preemption watch but no rewrite this week.

Bridges consistently and correctly read 'industry substrate present, no CA/NY/TX legislative artifact yet' (latest validation.5aa6893d5846cca8, May 31). No new contradict signal; records remain accurate.
Legislator-counsel, Okta-IdP, and EU-Article-26 Needs all target Q3 2026 and remain open; no actor has delivered the statute or a superseding artifact. Tasks stay on-track.

Existing chain (Agent-Control-Plane / MCPwn-OWASP / OAuth-scope upstreams) and 11 parallel relations remain valid; no upstream landed or got contradicted this week and no new edge candidate emerged. Noop.
